verdict.rationale: Make has a dedicated 'AI Agents' app (make-docs-9) for agentic automation within workflows, implying model choice and tool use, but the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation detailing how to configure model selection or tool/function definitions within an agent step — most evidence instead focuses on the MCP server (which exposes Make scenarios as tools to external AI clients like Claude/ChatGPT, the reverse direction). missing for 10: detailed docs on adding an AI/LLM step inside a scenario, configuring model provider/choice, and defining tool use within that step, plus independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
